svg.text: C1 case: a start-goal swap changes the solver status
HCA · run 1 · case 1,262 · Paris_2 source map · 128×128 grid, 100 agents
Actual input map (same for both runs)
C1 flag: the paired inputs have the same map and reversed start-goal assignments, but reported solvability differs.
The other six MR runs were solved. The agent pair shown above is real input data, not a path trace.
Source: retained HCA repeat_01/case_01262 input.map, input.txt, and result.txt files from the formal RQ1 batch.
This is a metamorphic completeness flag under the configured solver settings, not a traced root cause.
